title: reportDamageOnReturn
description: Subscribed to `ToolReturned` on the dispatcher by `subscribePolicies`. When the condition is `needs_repair` it invokes `ToolService.reportDamage` (TL-LEND-CMD03-H), in that handler's own transaction, with the return note as the damage note, or "Returned needing repair." when there is none. It runs after the return commits; if it fails, the dispatcher logs the failure and the return stands.
